arguments.prompt: Create a NEW genuine detailed 16-bit pixel-art SOURCE ATLAS. Use the attached art only as a character-design reference, not as frames to duplicate. All figures face screen right. Every figure is independently drawn with a distinct pose and the same body proportions. All full heads, full feet and full equipment must be completely visible with very wide transparent gutters between figures and a generous outer transparent border of at least 60 pixels. No figure or weapon may touch another cell or a canvas edge. Transparent background; no floor, shadow, grid, text, labels, scenery or other characters. Solo non-graphic animation acting, no victim, blood or injury. EXACTLY SIXTEEN full-body figures in FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS (4x4). Adult Max Payne from Max Payne 2 (2003): short dark hair, stubble, dark brown leather coat over dark shirt, dark trousers, boots, one physical Beretta 9mm pistol, as attached. ROW1 four new IDLE breathing/weight-shift poses with pistol held safely NOFLASH. ROW2 four new RUN locomotion poses with pistol retained safely NOFLASH. ROW3 four new ORDINARY SHOT poses: brace, aim NOFLASH, tiny attached muzzle flash at barrel tip in THIRD pose only, recover NOFLASH. ROW4 four new HIT REACTION protective-recoil/recovery poses, NOFLASH. Whole calves, boots, toes and coat tails must be visible with space below the soles. Never crop bodies at knees or ankles. No supernatural aura or slowed-time painting. Four complete figures in each of four rows.
